hero.headline: Build the Future of
hero.description: Join a team of engineers and innovators designing hardware that runs critical infrastructure across 26 countries. We build real products that go into the field.

cultureSection.heading: Where Engineers
cultureSection.description: We are a product company at heart. Every engineer at Invendis sees their work deployed in telecom towers, solar farms, and industrial sites — not just in a staging environment.

perks.title: Hardware That Ships
perks.description: Work on embedded systems, PCB design, and cellular connectivity that goes into real deployments across India and Africa.

perks.title: Global Exposure
perks.description: Our products operate in 26+ countries. You will engage with international OEM partners, towercos, and utilities.

perks.title: Small Team, Big Impact
perks.description: As a lean team, you own your work end to end — from design to production to field deployment.

perks.title: Grow with the Company
perks.description: IIoT and 5G are reshaping infrastructure. Join early and grow as the market expands rapidly.

noOpeningsMessage: We don't have any open roles right now, but we are always interested in hearing from talented engineers.

ctaBanner.heading: Don't see the right role?
ctaBanner.description: Send us your CV and a note about what you want to build. We review every application.
